description: This PHP source file defines the MenuDao class, which extends BaseDao and provides data access methods related to menu items within the OrangeHRM system. The class includes functions to enable/disable menu items for modules, fetch menu items based on module and screen names, get side panel and top menu items filtered by user roles, and retrieve menu items by title or module name.

classes.name: MenuDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for performing database operations related to menu items within the OrangeHRM system, including enabling/disabling menu items, fetching specific menu items, and retrieving menu hierarchies based on user roles.

methods.name: enableModuleMenuItems
methods.description: Enables menu items for a specific module, optionally filtering by menu titles.

methods.name: updateStatusOfModuleMenuItems
methods.description: Internal method to update the status (enable/disable) of menu items for a given module and optional list of menu titles.

methods.name: getMenuItemByModuleAndScreen
methods.description: Fetches a menu item based on the module name and screen name.

methods.name: getSidePanelMenuItems
methods.description: Retrieves top-level menu items for the side panel based on user roles.

methods.name: getTopMenuItems
methods.description: Retrieves second-level menu items as top menu entries for a given side menu item, including their hierarchical children, based on user roles.

methods.name: getMenuItemQueryBuilderWrapper
methods.description: Constructs a query builder wrapper for fetching menu items accessible to specified user roles.

methods.name: getMenuItemByTitle
methods.description: Retrieves a menu item by its title and optional level.

methods.name: getModuleByName
methods.description: Fetches a module entity by its name.
